notFound.body: Ye safha mojood nahi hai, ya ise muntaqil kar diya gaya hai.

comingSoon.title: {feature} jald aa raha hai
comingSoon.body: EduBridge AI ka ye hissa abhi ban raha hai. Account bana lijiye, tayyar hote hi aap ke liye dastyab hoga.

role.title: EduBridge AI mein khush aamdeed
role.subtitle: Aage barhne ke liye apna kirdar muntakhab karein. Hum aap ke taleemi safar ke mutabiq tajurba tarteeb denge.
role.studentBody: Tasdeeq shuda nisab, bamaani AI tuition aur zati mutalie ke mansoobe tak rasai hasil karein.
role.teacherBody: Talaba ki paish raft dekhein, board se tasdeeq shuda mawad dein, aur har talib ilm ki madad karein.
role.parentBody: Digital tahaffuz yaqeeni banayein, tasdeeq shuda paish raft reports dekhein, aur taleemi kamyabiyon mein shareek hon.

student.title: Talib ilm ka account banayein

student.groupHelp: Ikhtiyarat aap ki muntakhab class par munhasir hain.
student.reviewIntro: Account banane se pehle tasdeeq kar lein ke ye durust hain.
student.consentBody: Class 9 aur 10 ke talaba ke liye AI Tutor istemal karne se pehle sarparast ki tasdeeq lazmi hai.

teacher.title: Asatza ki registration
teacher.subtitle: Apne talaba ki nigrani aur madad ke liye platform mein shamil hon.

errors.invalidClassGroup: Ye group aap ki muntakhab class ke liye dastyab nahi.
errors.captchaFailed: Security check mukammal nahi hua, phir se koshish karain.
errors.rateLimited: Bohat zyada koshishein. Barah-e-karam thori dair baad dobara koshish karein.
errors.generic: Kuch ghalat ho gaya. Dobara koshish karein.
errors.enumsTitle: Class aur mazameen ke ikhtiyarat load nahi ho sake
errors.enumsBody: Durust ikhtiyarat dikhane ke liye form ko in ki zaroorat hai.

login.title: EduBridge AI mein khush aamdeed
login.subtitle: Apna seekhne ka safar jaari rakhne ke liye sign in karein.
login.heroTitle: Apne nisaab par aitmaad ke saath uboor haasil karein.
login.heroBody: Tasdeeq shuda board content, zaati noiyat ki AI tuition aur aap ki kamyabi ke liye tayyar kiye gaye study plans haasil karein.

adminLogin.title: Admin sign in
adminLogin.subtitle: Yeh raasta sirf platform administrators ke liye hai.
adminLogin.notice: Admin accounts baraah-e-raast banaye jaate hain. Is safhe se na account banaya ja sakta hai aur na password tabdeel ho sakta hai.

twoFactor.title: Do marhalon wali tasdeeq
twoFactor.promptTotp: Mehfooz tareeqe se aage barhne ke liye apni authenticator app se 6 hindson ka code darj karein.
twoFactor.promptEmail: Hum ne {email} par jo 6 hindson ka code bheja hai wo darj karein.
twoFactor.promptBackup: Aap ne jo 8 huroof wale backup codes mehfooz kiye thay, un mein se aik darj karein.
twoFactor.expiresIn: Code ki miyaad khatam hone mein
twoFactor.optionsBody: Apni shanakht ki tasdeeq ke liye mutabadil tareeqa muntakhib karein.
twoFactor.methodTotpBody: Apni app se 6 hindson ka code istemal karein
twoFactor.methodEmailBody: {email} par bheja gaya 6 hindson ka code istemal karein
twoFactor.methodBackupBody: Mehfooz kiye gaye 8 huroof wale codes mein se aik istemal karein
twoFactor.expiredTitle: Sign in ki ye darkhwast khatam ho gayi
twoFactor.expiredBody: Aap ki hifazat ke liye code ki darkhwast ka waqt khatam ho gaya. Naya code haasil karne ke liye dobara sign in karein.

locked.title: Account aarzi tor par band hai
locked.body: Tasdeeq ki bohot ziyada nakaam koshishein. Aap ki hifazat ke liye ye account band kar diya gaya hai.

countdown.lessThanAMinute: Aik minute se kam baqi hai.
countdown.finished: Intezaar khatam. Ab dobara koshish kar sakte hain.

errors.badCredentials: Ye email aur password kisi account se mel nahi khaate.
errors.captchaFailed: Security check mukammal nahi hua, phir se koshish karain.
errors.invalidCode: Ye code durust nahi. Dobara koshish karein.
errors.rateLimited: Bohot ziyada koshishein. Baraye meherbani thori der baad dobara koshish karein.
errors.rateLimitedIn: Bohot ziyada koshishein. Aap dobara koshish kar sakte hain
errors.generic: Kuch ghalat ho gaya. Dobara koshish karein.

enroll.title: Apna account mehfooz banayein
enroll.subtitle: EduBridge AI sign in ke waqt doosre factor ka taqaza karta hai. Muntakhib karein ke aap codes kaise wasool karna chahte hain.
enroll.totpOptionBody: Google Authenticator, Authy ya isi tarah ki app se QR code scan karein
enroll.emailOptionBody: Har bar sign in par email ke zariye 6 hindson ka code haasil karein
enroll.mandatoryNote: Har EduBridge AI account ke liye doosra factor lazmi hai. Aap baad mein Settings se tareeqa badal sakte hain.
enroll.totpBody: Apni authenticator app kholein, neeche diya code scan karein, phir jo 6 hindson ka code zahir ho wo darj karein.
enroll.qrAlt: Authenticator app tarteeb dene ke liye QR code
enroll.secretLabel: Scan nahi ho raha? Iske bajaye ye key darj karein
enroll.emailBody: Hum ne {email} par 6 hindson ka code bheja hai. Tarteeb mukammal karne ke liye neeche darj karein.
enroll.codeExpiresIn: Code ki miyaad khatam hone mein

backupCodes.title: Apne backup codes mehfooz karein
backupCodes.body: Ye sirf aik bar dikhaye jate hain. Agar aap ka doosra factor dastyab na ho to har code aik bar kaam aata hai.
backupCodes.copyFailed: Khudkar tor par copy nahi ho saka. Upar diye codes muntakhib kar ke khud copy karein.
backupCodes.downloadFailed: File download nahi ho saki. Aage barhne se pehle upar diye codes muntakhib kar ke kisi mehfooz jagah par mehfooz kar lein.
backupCodes.fileHeading: EduBridge AI backup codes — har code aik bar kaam karta hai.
backupCodes.acknowledge: Main ne ye codes mehfooz jagah par rakh liye hain. Mujhe maloom hai ke ye dobara nahi dikhaye jayenge.

checkEmail.title: Apni email dekhein
checkEmail.body: Hum ne {email} par tasdeeqi link bheja hai. Account faal karne ke liye ise kholein.
checkEmail.bodyUnknown: Hum ne aap ke registered pate par tasdeeqi link bheja hai. Account faal karne ke liye ise kholein.
checkEmail.spamHint: Agar chand minute mein na pohanche to apna spam folder dekhein.

verifyEmail.verifyingTitle: Aap ki email ki tasdeeq ho rahi hai
verifyEmail.verifyingBody: Is mein sirf aik lamha lagega.
verifyEmail.verifiedBody: Aap ki email ki tasdeeq ho chuki hai. Aap ka mehfooz taleemi mahol tayyar hai.
verifyEmail.invalidBody: Ye tasdeeqi link durust nahi ya pehle istemal ho chuka hai. Baraye meherbani naya link mangwayein.
verifyEmail.expiredBody: Aap ki hifazat ke liye tasdeeqi link ki miyaad khatam ho jati hai. Baraye meherbani nayi tasdeeqi email mangwayein.

forgotPassword.title: Password dobara tarteeb dein
forgotPassword.subtitle: Apna registered email address darj karein. Hum aap ko password badalne ke liye mehfooz link bhejenge.
forgotPassword.sentBody: Agar {email} ke liye account mojood hai to hum ne us par password recovery link bhej diya hai.
forgotPassword.spamHint: Agar chand minute mein na pohanche to apna spam folder dekhein.

resetPassword.title: Password dobara tarteeb dein
resetPassword.subtitle: Apne account ke liye naya, mehfooz password banayein.
resetPassword.rule_uppercase: Aik bara angrezi harf shamil ho
resetPassword.rule_number: Aik hindsa ya alamat shamil ho
resetPassword.mismatch: Dono passwords aik jaise hone chahiyen.
resetPassword.doneBody: Aap ka password badal diya gaya hai. Naye password se sign in karein.
resetPassword.expiredBody: Aap ki hifazat ke liye reset link ki miyaad khatam ho jati hai. Baraye meherbani naya mangwayein.
resetPassword.invalidBody: Ye reset link durust nahi ya pehle istemal ho chuka hai. Baraye meherbani naya mangwayein.

guardian.title: Waldain ka rabt lazmi hai
guardian.subtitle: Jamaat nohum aur dahum ke talaba ke liye AI Tutor khulne se pehle waldain ya sarparast ki manzoori zaroori hai.
guardian.railBody: Jamaat nohum ta dahum ke talaba ke liye hum munsalik Guardian Space ka taqaza karte hain taake digital tahaffuz yaqeeni ho, taleemi diyanat barqarar rahe, aur waldain tasdeeq shuda nisabi peshraft moassar tor par dekh sakein.
guardian.explainer: Aap ke waldain ko email mosool hogi, wo apna account banayenge aur usi se rabt ki manzoori denge.
guardian.selfLinkError: Ye aap ke walid/walida ya sarparast ka pata hona chahiye, aap ka apna nahi.
guardian.loading: Aap ke guardian rabt ki janch ho rahi hai…
guardian.pendingBody: Hum ne {email} par email bheji hai. Manzoori milte hi ye safha khud badal jayega.
guardian.waiting: Aap ke waldain ki manzoori ka intezaar hai…
guardian.verifiedBody: Aap ke waldain ne rabt ki manzoori de di hai. Aap ka account tayyar hai.
guardian.notFoundError: Is address par abhi koi parent account mojood nahi. Un se pehle sign up karne ko kahen, phir invitation dobara bhejein.

guardianConfirm.title: Apne bache ke account ki manzoori dein
guardianConfirm.subtitle: Aap ke bache ne aap se apne EduBridge AI account ki manzoori mangi hai. Tasdeeq se aap ke accounts munsalik ho jayenge.
guardianConfirm.step1: Aap ka bacha apne board aur jamaat ke liye AI Tutor aur mutalie ki sahoolat istemal kar sakega.
guardianConfirm.step2: Aap apne dashboard se un ki peshraft ki reportein aur mutalie ki sargarmi dekh sakenge.
guardianConfirm.step3: Aap un ki tuition guftagu ka mawad nahi dekh sakenge — wo aap ke bache ke liye niji rehti hai.
guardianConfirm.signInFirst: Manzoori dene se pehle aap ka apna parent account zaroori hai.
guardianConfirm.confirmedBody: Ab aap {student} ke account se munsalik hain.
guardianConfirm.alreadyBody: Ye account pehle hi munsalik hai. Yahan mazeed kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi.
guardianConfirm.invalidBody: Ye dawati link durust nahi, is ki miyaad khatam ho chuki hai ya pehle istemal ho chuka hai. Apne bache se naya link bhejne ko kahein.
guardianConfirm.selfLinkError: Koi account apna sarparast nahi ban sakta.
guardianConfirm.notAParentError: Sirf parent account is rabt ki manzoori de sakta hai.
guardianConfirm.confirmedBodyNoName: Aap ab apne bachay ke account se link ho chuke hain.

hero.subtitle: Pakistani nisab par mabni aik aala karkardagi wala taleemi nizam, jo talaba ko unki apni zaban mein AI ki madad deta hai.

solutions.title: Har Talib Ilm ko Baikhtiyar Banana
solutions.subtitle: Jadeed classroom ki zarooriyat ke liye tayyar karda moassar zaraye.

students.title: 24/7 AI Tutor aur Hal
students.body: Science aur math aise tutor ke sath samjhein jo aap ki raftar ke mutabiq dhalta hai, aur apni pasandeeda zaban mein gehri wazahat hasil karein.
students.featureLanguages: English, Urdu aur Roman-Urdu ki sahulat
students.featureMethod: Sawal jawab ke zariye seekhne ka tareeqa
students.previewAnswer: Ye raha wo sawal, aik aik qadam kar ke hal kiya gaya.

teachers.title: Classroom ki Baseerat
teachers.body: Nisab ki kamiyon ko fori tor par pehchanein aur talaba ki paish raft tafseeli dashboards se dekhein.

parents.title: Be-misal Shaffafiyat
parents.body: Apne bache ke taleemi safar se mehfooz aur ghair mudakhilati paish raft reports ke zariye jure rahein.
parents.cardMasteryBody: Tamam boards mein karkardagi ki fori nigrani.
parents.cardPlannerBody: Imtihan ke liye AI se tayyar karda dohrai schedule.

capabilities.title: Bunyadi Salahiyatein
capabilities.subtitle: Ilmi imtiyaz aur takneeki hifazat ki bunyad par.
capabilities.curriculumBody: Board imtihan mein kamyabi ke liye PCTB aur STBB ke mutabiq.
capabilities.bilingualBody: English aur Urdu mein mukammal rawani, riyazi ki alamat samet.
capabilities.groundedBody: Mehfooz AI nizam jawabat ko tasdeeq shuda nisabi mawad par qaim rakhta hai.
capabilities.adaptiveBody: Fehm ki satah ke mutabiq dushwari ki khudkar tabdeeli.

student.subtitle: Aap ka nisab, aap ki raftaar, aap ki zaban mein.

teacher.subtitle: Aap ki classein aur wo nisabi khala jin par tawajjo zaroori hai.

parent.subtitle: Aap ke bache ki peshraft, baghair musalsal nigrani ke.

admin.subtitle: Accounts ki farahmi, nisaab ki taazgi, security ki soorat-e-haal aur quotas.

cards.performanceBody: Aap ke mazameen mein imtehani tayyari aur nisab ki takmeel.
cards.studyNextBody: Un mauzuaat ko tarjeeh jahan aap ki girift kamzor hai.
cards.tutorBody: English, Urdu ya Roman Urdu mein sawal poochein aur qadam ba qadam hal samjhein.
cards.quizzesBody: Aap ke board aur jamaat se liye gaye mashqi sawalat.
cards.myClassesBody: Dekhein kon aap ki peshraft dekh sakta hai, aur kisi bhi waqt class chor dein.
cards.spacesBody: Wo classein jo aap parhate hain aur un ki peshraft.
cards.rosterBody: Kon shamil hai, aur kon abhi shamil nahi hua.
cards.reportsBody: Aap ke dayra-e-tadrees ke mazameen ki peshraft.
cards.sloBody: Aap ki class ne kon se taleemi maqasid mukammal kiye aur kon se baqi hain.
cards.childProgressBody: Tasdeeq shuda nisabi peshraft aur waqt ke sath mutalie ki sargarmi.
cards.howToHelpBody: Un maqamat par amali tajaweez jahan aap ke bache ko dushwari ho rahi hai.
cards.privacyTitle: Aap kya dekh sakte hain aur kya nahi
cards.privacyBody: Aap peshraft reportein aur mutalie ki sargarmi dekh sakte hain. Aap apne bache ki tuition guftagu ka mawad nahi parh sakte — wo bah lihaz-e-design un ke liye niji rehti hai.
cards.provisioningBody: Poore platform par accounts, kirdar aur idara jaati rasai.
cards.curriculumAdminBody: Boards, jamaatein aur mazameen, aur mansalik nisaab kitna taaza hai.
cards.securityBody: Agent software bill of materials, model janch ke record aur khule masail.
cards.quotasBody: Har account aur har idare ki istemal ki hudood, aur kaun un ke qareeb hai.
cards.endpointLogsBody: Kin endpoints ko, kitne accounts ne aur kitni baar istemal kiya. Sirf metadata.
cards.adminPrivacyBody: Aap audit record, rasai logs aur istemal ka metadata dekh sakte hain. Aap kisi bhi tuition guftagu ka mawad nahi parh sakte — bah lihaz-e-design admin ke liye us tak koi raasta mojood hi nahi.

plan.title: Apna taleemi rasta muntakhib karein
plan.subtitle: Aap ke board ke tasdeeq shuda nisab par mabni zaati AI tuition tak mukammal rasai.
plan.planBody: Aik hi plan. Sab kuch shamil.
plan.feature_tutor: Aap ke board aur jamaat ke liye lamehdood AI tuition
plan.feature_curriculum: Tasdeeq shuda PCTB aur STBB nisab
plan.feature_analytics: Peshraft ki nigrani aur imtehani tayyari
plan.feature_languages: Har jagah English, Urdu aur Roman Urdu
plan.loading: Aap ki rasai ki janch ho rahi hai…
plan.trialEnds: Aap ki muft aazmaish {date} tak hai.
plan.noAccess: Aap ke paas faal rasai nahi. Jari rakhne ke liye plan muntakhib karein.
plan.noCheckoutNote: Yahan abhi koi adaigi nahi li jati. Plan muntakhib karne se aap ka intekhab mehfooz ho jata hai; billing aainda release mein aayegi.
